pages.title: Przewalski's Horse
pages.text: Przewalski's horse ($(o)Equus ferus przewalskii$()) is a rare wild horse of the steppes of Central Asia, native to Mongolia and northern China.$(br2)It is stocky and dun-coloured, with a short, erect mane and no forelock.$(br2)Przewalski's horse became extinct in the wild in the 1960s, but horses bred from a small captive population have since been reintroduced to Mongolia and other parts of its former range.
